name: K.A.I.R.O.S — Elite Dev
description: K.A.I.R.O.S - Kinetic Artificial Intelligence Real-time Operational System — AI Voice Assistant by Elite Dev
_comment_display: B8: was 'fullscreen', which hides the status bar — no clock, no battery, no signal. That reads as broken rather than immersive. 'standalone' keeps the system bar and still looks like a real app. display_override gives desktop PWAs a native window.
_comment_orientation: B8: 'portrait-primary' locked out tablets and landscape entirely. 'any' lets the layout adapt.
_comment_icons: B7 FIX: 'any' now points at the real square 192/512 marks and 'maskable' at dedicated maskable files (extra safe-zone padding) instead of reusing a non-square image — this removes the cropped-logo look on Android. Files live in the served root.

shortcuts.description: Type to K.A.I.R.O.S instead of speaking
